messages:
Alex: Quick sync — final cutover cadence for tonight's release at 22:00 UTC. Posting a compact pre-deploy checklist; please ack and call out any blockers.

Priya: Ack, I'll own canary monitoring and smoke dashboards. what's the canary split?

Alex: Canary at 10% for 15m, then 50% for 10m if healthy, then full. rollback triggers: error-rate > 1.5x baseline or p95 latency +200ms.

Mike: I can run the DB migration guard on the side channel and stay staged. Migration is zero-downtime, but I've got a toggle fallback.

Sara: I'll be on post-deploy oncall for the first 30m and run the functional smoke set. Sharing test commands below.

Sara: ```
# smoke script
./scripts/smoke-run --env=prod --profile=quick
# quick API checks
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate | jq '.status'
```

Jing: Quick Q — do we need a feature-flag gate for the new batching change? If yes, I'll add a kill switch.

Alex: Yes, add a runtime flag: feature.batch_v2. We'll gate the model route. If things go sideways, flip to false. Jing please add and validate in staging by 19:30 UTC.

Jing: On it, will post the flag toggle command when done.

Taylor: CI preview passed, but FYI one flaky test in tokenizer-utils. I re-ran it; passed second time. No blocker but watching.

Priya: I'll validate traces 5m into canary and at 50% ramp. I'll post links to dashboards in thread when ready.

Mike: Migration plan snippet: 1) pre-check row counts 2) apply schema change in non-blocking mode 3) backfill batch in small chunks 4) verify checksums 5) promote. Rollback: run migrate down then re-route traffic.

Alex: Final checklist (please react with :white_check_mark: when done):
- @Mike DB migration reviewed and staged
- @Jing feature.batch_v2 flag in place
- @Priya dashboards wired for canary
- @Sara smoke scripts validated
- @Taylor flaky test acknowledged
- @Alex deploy window confirmed (22:00 UTC)

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment for project/inference-runtime at 2026-04-23T22:00:00Z. Canary: 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Notified #eng-oncall.

Priya: Dashboards posted: https://monitoring.redwood.example/d/xyz/canary-overview (will comment on any anomalies)

Jing: feature flag added. Toggle commands:
```bash
# enable
ffcli set feature.batch_v2 true --env prod
# disable
ffcli set feature.batch_v2 false --env prod
```

Mike: DB pre-check done. Row counts match. Backfill plan queued. :white_check_mark:

Sara: Smoke script run on staging OK. Ready to execute post-deploy smoke. :white_check_mark:

Taylor: Noted flaky test; won't block. :white_check_mark:

Alex: Thanks — I see all checks. I'll flip the final go 10 minutes before window and post timestamp. If anyone needs to opt out, speak now.

Priya: Go for me.

Jing: Go from my side.

Mike: Go.

Sara: Go. I'll be on watch.

deploy-bot: Deployment window begins in 10 minutes. Remember to run post-deploy smoke and file any regressions under #incidents if severity >= P2.
